exposure: Midtrimester isolated short femur length (<5th percentile for gestational age)
outcome: Being small for gestational age (birth weight <10th percentile)
Being small for gestational age (birth weight <3rd percentile)
cohort: The study included 2,105 women, comprising 85 with midtrimester femur length <5th percentile for gestational age and 2,020 controls.
finding: Midtrimester isolated short femur length is significantly associated with higher rates of being small for gestational age and severe preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Exposure (femur length) was measured during the midtrimester.
birth_weight: The study investigated birth weight <10th percentile and <3rd percentile for gestational age as outcomes.
gest_age: Gestational age was used to define femur length percentiles and to determine outcomes such as small for gestational age, with exposure measured in midtrimester.
